title: Is Large Language Model-Assisted Citation Screening Feasible in a Scoping Review on Nonpharmacological Interventions for Delirium in Patients With Cancer?

live_model.evidence: Abstract: 'three LLMs, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4o, and model o1...The sensitivity and specificity were 0.43 (95% CI, 0.06-0.80) and 0.99 (95% CI, 0.99-1.00) for GPT-4 Turbo' (vs. reference standard 1, title/abstract)
